Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer at step 11 failed to correctly interpret the data from the Wikipedia page, which explicitly lists the death place as "Weston-under-Lizard," instead of recognizing that "Weston Park" (from ThePeerage) and "Weston-under-Lizard" refer to the same location. This misinterpretation of the upstream data prevented the agents from synthesizing a consistent final answer, leading to the incorrect conclusion that the sources disagreed.
